HirePro Online Proctoring technology is crafted by a team of seasoned experts with 20+ patents
and decades of collective experience in audio and video technologies.
The brave new world of
live and automated proctoring
Choose to monitor tests live with human proctors or rely
on our AI-powered auto proctoring. Live proctors can
verify the ID of candidates, monitor video and audio
feeds, chat with candidates, pause tests, and disqualify
candidates in case of violations. Get a final score of
high/medium/low/no suspicion for each candidate with
AI-powered proctoring.
Stay confident with
impersonation detection
Ensure that only genuine candidates take your test.
Prevent and detect impersonation through AI-powered
ID verification and face matching for both live as well
as auto-proctored tests.
Exceptionally vigilant video, audio,
and image monitoring
Monitor the complete test session to detect fraudulent
behaviours such as candidate change, third-person,
cross-conversations, missing candidate, and blocked
camera. Serve up live warnings to the candidates through
the AI engine or by live proctors.
Browser monitoring that
keeps you in control
Monitor and automatically logout candidates on
standard browsers for violations such as switching
tabs quite often, moving out of the test window for too
long, and for exiting full screen. Tighten the
monitoring further with our safe browser to block
screen sharing, screen mirroring, and more.
Complete session recording
keeps you informed
Stay compliant and ready for audits with complete
session recording which includes video, audio, images,
browser session, violations auto-highlighted with
timestamps, and detailed logs.
Agile infrastructure and adaptable
bandwidth requirements
Proctor candidates on Windows, Mac, Chromebooks,
and Android Phones/Tablets. Our platform runs
flawlessly even on 3 to 5-year-old hardware and
requires only 128 kbps of internet speed.
